newsitem.title: INDIA: All bids at Indian 91-day t-bill auction rejected.
newsitem.headline: All bids at Indian 91-day t-bill auction rejected.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday it rejected all the bids received at its weekly auction of 91-day treasury bills.
The RBI said it received 12 bids for a total of 1.0 billion rupees, all of which it rejected.
The devolvement on the RBI was 4.32 billion rupees and that on primary dealers was 680 million rupees, the RBI said.
The weighted average cut-off rate was 98.10 rupees.
